title: Drop the session-start red check from the preamble
action: In session_preamble/budget.rs, the declared-test branch (~597-617) renders: '- Never build on red: run the test command above before your first `cells claim`, and treat a red as its own fix-first cell. CI runs the same command on every push and PR.' Per D3, drop the mandatory pre-claim full-suite instruction. Replace the WHOLE line including its '- Never build on red:' opening with the proof-per-change-type doctrine (D5): the agent picks the proof its change type needs — related tests for code, parity checks for docs — and records it in the cap proof line; CI runs the full declared command on every push (D4, keep that clause). Keep the no-test-sentinel branch's alternative line consistent with the same doctrine. The pins in session_preamble/tests.rs:145,157 are PREFIX asserts on '- Never build on red:' (not byte pins) — replace both with assertions that pin the NEW line's full text byte-for-byte, one positive (declared-test repo renders it) and one negative (the old opening never renders). Extend the comment block above the line (~606-614) with one line naming decision D3 (58ec9664). No mechanical dep on slice 1 — the serial D9 ordering is satisfied at feature close, so this cell may start immediately.
